t: A cheap 2026 STM32 chip family with a fast Cortex-M33 core.
steps: Buy a NUCLEO-C542RC from the ST eStore for about 21 US dollars.
Add the STM32duino board package in the Boards Manager.
Plug the board into your computer with a USB-C cable.
Pick the Nucleo-64 board and the C542 chip in the Tools menu.
Upload the Blink example and watch the light flash.
Try ST's STM32CubeMX2 tool later for bigger C projects.
